# Calendar 1.3.0

This release adds calendar gesture navigation, custom color themes, encrypted offline synchronization and an optional local AI model. It includes the changes from `feature/navigation-themes-encrypted-sync` through `987c7937434df2109ff501431dc7ebaa8cbd5034` and the subsequent model integration fixes.

## Navigation

- Swipe left/right to navigate the year, month, week, day and agenda views. Each view advances by its own period; agenda advances by a month and displays the following 60 days.
- Use Left/Right arrows or A/D on desktop. Shortcuts respect text entry, dialogs, PIN lock, selections, composition and modifier keys.
- Preserve vertical scrolling, taps, event editing and existing navigation buttons. Slower swipes no longer fail because of an arbitrary gesture duration limit. Transitions respect reduced-motion preferences.
- Added browser/desktop navigation regressions and Android tests using explicit touchscreen finger events.

## Custom themes

- Create, edit, select and delete local custom palettes alongside the seven built-in themes.
- Customize 13 interface colors with live application of saved palettes and contrast notices. Cancel discards drafts; deleting the active custom theme restores Dark OLED.
- Store up to 32 named custom themes with validated hex colors. Synchronization can include the active custom palette; event colors retain their meaning.

## Encrypted offline synchronization

- Added password-protected KAL3 text codes and multipart QR frames/images. Payloads are compressed locally and encrypted with AES-256-GCM; PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256 uses a fresh salt and 600,000 iterations.
- Require a password of at least 12 characters. Passwords are transient and are not stored in settings, exports or QR codes. Share the password separately from the encrypted code.
- Authenticate before decompression/import. Incorrect passwords, damaged payloads and conflicting QR parts cannot import events. Duplicate/reordered identical parts are supported, with bounded size and assembly lifetime.
- Retain KAL2, legacy JSON and ICS imports with explicit warnings and confirmation. Plain JSON exports remain unencrypted. Update both devices before exchanging KAL3 codes.

## Optional local AI assistant

- Added LFM2.5 350M Q4_K_M inference through bundled wllama/llama.cpp WebAssembly. Download or import the optional 229 MB official GGUF; verify its size and SHA-256 before saving and loading. The weights are separate from application downloads and calendar backups.
- Support local model installation, progress, cancellation, removal and offline persistence. Interrupted or invalid downloads preserve an existing installation. Main and compatibility WASM engines ship with the app; no inference service or runtime CDN is used.
- Extract schema-constrained commands with bounded conversation history. Explicit imperative verbs narrow the permitted actions while indirect, revised and negated requests retain the complete action vocabulary.
- Validate dates, times and fields, reject unsupported optional details, and anchor recognized relative dates to calendar calculations. Preserve existing durations or use the one-hour default when the request does not specify an end. Handle midnight/month rollover and date-filtered searches, including events spanning a day.
- Improve English extraction with English prompt examples. Fix accidental editing instead of creation, leaked relative-date words in titles, generic event nouns in searches and invented date filters that hid matching events.
- Keep creation/edit/deletion proposals subject to review and explicit confirmation, with stale-preview protection and undo. No inference automatically saves calendar changes.
- Shorten the prompt (the first English test request decreased from 863 to 719 prompt tokens). Run inference in a worker, use greedy decoding, allow up to four threads with cross-origin isolation, and release model memory after inactivity. Development/preview servers now send the isolation headers; production hosts need equivalent headers for threading.
- Preserve English, Polish, Russian and German interfaces and existing language choices. English remains the default. Selected real-model language tests cover English and Polish; this does not establish general language accuracy, especially for Polish/Russian, which are not primary model languages.

## Verification and known limitations

- TypeScript/lint, production web build and **84/84 unit tests** passed.
- Actual verified GGUF weights passed **8/8 English and 8/8 Polish offline browser scenarios**: create, move, search, delete/undo, relative dates, weekday, midnight and Warsaw daylight-saving transition. Tests verify exact names/dates/times, confirmation, stored records, model persistence and absence of external requests.
- On the Linux Chromium test host, first responses took about **30 seconds**, same-prefix warm responses about **3–5.4 seconds**, and changing the reference date required **22–26 seconds**. These are host observations, not phone performance guarantees.
- **Android AI inference remains unverified.** Debug application and instrumentation APKs built and installed on Android 15. The software-only emulator's WebView stopped answering before the first model request; the attempt ended at a 420-second deadline. A physical device or accelerated emulator is still needed to validate Android inference and latency. APK compilation alone is not a model test.
- Packaged Electron model inference has not been separately verified. Platform package smoke tests do not replace real-model validation.
- See [the detailed model verification report](https://github.com/vex2137/Kalendarz/blob/v1.3.0/docs/local-model-verification.md) and [navigation/themes/sync documentation](https://github.com/vex2137/Kalendarz/blob/v1.3.0/docs/NAVIGATION_THEMES_SYNC.md).

## Downloads

The publication workflow builds and checks all platform packages before publishing them:

- **Android:** `Calendar-1.3.0-android-test.apk` — signed with an Android development key, not a Google Play release.
- **Windows x64:** `Calendar-1.3.0-windows-x64-setup.exe`, `Calendar-1.3.0-windows-x64-portable.exe`, `Calendar-1.3.0-windows-x64.zip`. No commercial Authenticode signature.
- **Linux x64:** `Calendar-1.3.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, `Calendar-1.3.0-linux-x86_64.flatpak` (Flathub runtimes required).
- **Web/PWA:** `Calendar-1.3.0-web.zip` for HTTPS hosting. Open online once to enable offline use; install the model separately.
- **Integrity:** `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all seven packages.

Export a calendar backup before upgrading. Android cannot update an APK signed with a different key; uninstalling deletes local data, including installed model weights. Local model storage and performance depend on the browser/device. Review AI proposals before applying them.
